Help & FAQs

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about our washing, dry cleaning, pricing, pickup, and delivery in the Blue City of Jodhpur.

We provide free doorstep pickup and delivery across all major areas of Jodhpur, including Ratanada, Shastri Nagar, Sardarpura, Paota, AIIMS Road, Chopasni, Mandore, Basni, and the historic Old Blue City. We also serve all major hotels, heritage havelis, Airbnbs, and hostels.

Standard wash & fold or wash & steam iron takes 24 hours. However, if you are a tourist with an upcoming flight or train, our Express Service (4�6 hours) guarantees fast same-day turnaround!

Yes, absolutely! Just share your hotel or hostel name, room number, and your preferred pickup time over WhatsApp. We collect directly from the reception or your room doorstep, and drop them back neatly packed before you check out.

We use 100% RO purified soft water, fabric-safe German and international eco-friendly liquid detergents, and gentle fabric softeners. We never use harsh caustic powders or bleach that fade fabric colors.

Yes! We clean single and double blankets, heavy quilts/razai, curtains, carpets, and also do on-site sofa and upholstery shampooing across Jodhpur residences and guest houses.

We accept UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM), Indian & international cards, net banking, and Cash on Delivery (COD) once you verify your fresh clothes.

The fastest way is via WhatsApp at +91 82338 53727. You can also call us directly or use our online booking form.
